requirement: The system shall refuse a job application when the applicant has already applied for the same posting with the same email address.
The system shall compute a candidate's match score for a posting from overlap between required skills and the candidate's declared skills, weighted by the posting's skill importance.
The candidate selects a posting and uploads a CV; the system validates file size and type, stores the file and records the application.
The candidate enters keywords and a location; the system returns matching open postings ordered by how recently they were published.
As a candidate, I want to save postings to a shortlist so that I can revisit them before applying.
As a recruiter, I want to publish a job posting with title, description, required skills and closing date so that candidates can start applying.
A posting may not be edited once at least one application has been received; changes must be made by closing the posting and publishing a new one.
Every application status change must be recorded with the previous status, the new status, the actor and the time, to support recruiter audit.
The application table shall ensure that every application refers to an existing posting, has a candidate email present and a CV storage key recorded.

-- application table for the job portal
CREATE TABLE application (
    application_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    posting_id       BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    candidate_email  VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    cv_storage_key   VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    status           VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    submitted_at     TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT application_posting_fk FOREIGN KEY (posting_id) REFERENCES posting(posting_id),
    CONSTRAINT application_email_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(candidate_email)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT application_cv_key_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(cv_storage_key)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT application_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('SUBMITTED','SHORTLISTED','REJECTED','OFFERED','WITHDRAWN')),
    CONSTRAINT application_unique UNIQUE (posting_id, candidate_email)
);

CREATE INDEX application_posting_idx ON application (posting_id, status);

-- posting table for the job portal
CREATE TABLE posting (
    posting_id     BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    recruiter_id   VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    title          VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description    TEXT         NOT NULL,
    closes_on      DATE         NOT NULL,
    status         VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT posting_title_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT posting_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','OPEN','CLOSED','ARCHIVED'))
);
-- candidate profile table
CREATE TABLE candidate (
    candidate_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    email          VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    given_name     VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    family_name    VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    phone          VARCHAR(40),
    CONSTRAINT candidate_email_unique UNIQUE (email)
);

requirement: Only the recruiter who owns a posting may view applications to it; other recruiters must be refused.
The weekly digest job shall email each candidate a shortlist update summarising their applications that changed status in the past seven days.
